environment: future production-like 2 tenant x 2 person E2E

planned_surfaces: operator CLI or test harness result
operator-visible Slack response when the scenario enters through Slack
runtime log with no secret or customer payload
surface_contract.rule: A planned surface is not evidence that the surface exists. An unavailable observation remains not_collected with a next action.

common_assertions.correlation: request, visible rejection, OperationReceipt, authority receipt, and readback use the same correlation_id
common_assertions.unknown_handling: unknown and unavailable observations remain not_collected and include next_action

cases.entry_point: future Slack or CLI E2E request from Tenant A targeting Tenant B
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned Slack rejection or CLI result, sanitized runtime log, OperationReceipt readback
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across rejection and receipts
cases.next_action: after T0 and the runtime trust store exist, provision isolated Tenant A/B fixtures and collect the rejection plus receipt readback
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: each delivery is rejected; business effect remains zero

cases.entry_point: future Slack or CLI E2E request by Sato for Umeda Personal KG, and inverse
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned non-disclosing Slack rejection or CLI result, sanitized log, OperationReceipt readback
cases.expected_result: explicit owner or scope mismatch rejection code without existence disclosure
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across rejection and receipts
cases.next_action: after approved production-safe personas and trust infrastructure exist, collect both direction checks without exposing Personal KG content
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: each delivery is rejected; business effect remains zero

cases.entry_point: future provider-authenticated request whose subject has no canonical person
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE response, sanitized log, authority receipt readback
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across rejection and receipts
cases.next_action: create a non-customer unknown subject after T0 and trust-store readiness, then collect the fail-closed evidence
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: retry remains rejected until authoritative resolution exists

cases.entry_point: future provider-authenticated request resolving to multiple candidate persons
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE response, sanitized log, authority receipt readback
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across rejection and receipts
cases.next_action: prepare an approved ambiguous mapping fixture after T0 and collect explicit rejection evidence
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: retry remains rejected until ambiguity is resolved authoritatively

cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: redelivery of the stale context remains rejected with zero effect

cases.expected_result: explicit stale policy revision rejection code
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across rejection and receipts

cases.entry_point: future approval response from a person other than Brainbase approver_person_id
cases.scenario: approval by the wrong person or workspace
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned Slack rejection or CLI result, sanitized log, OperationReceipt and authority receipt readback
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id across approval response rejection and receipts
cases.next_action: after approval routing exists, submit an approved non-approver response without using customer data
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: repeated wrong-approver responses remain rejected with zero effect

cases.entry_point: future Queue redelivery with the same authority context, idempotency key, and correlation ID
cases.scenario: duplicate delivery after an accepted or rejected first delivery
cases.operator_visible_surface: planned CLI harness result, sanitized Queue log, OperationReceipt and external readback
cases.expected_result: duplicate delivery is identified and does not repeat the effect
cases.receipt_readback: same correlation_id and idempotency key link both deliveries and the single authoritative receipt chain
cases.next_action: after Queue and receipt readback are production-ready, redeliver the same envelope and compare effect counters
cases.retry_redelivery_expectation: effect count is exactly once across original delivery and redelivery; for a rejected original delivery it remains zero
